investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin re-rates higher as Binance hack tail risk clears and institutional staking adoption accelerates; BTC/USD outperforms SPY through Q3 2026.
supporting_signals: CNBC/BBC/CoinDesk: Binance 90% asset coverage + Sunday withdrawal resumption removes contagion fear.
CoinDesk: institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields—signals structural confidence in protocol layer.
CoinDesk: solo miners re-entering market as AI CapEx cycle spurs consolidation—supply pressure eases, upside optionality.
investment_theses.counter_view: Trump's unfulfilled energy pledges + actual fuel price surge could trigger broader macro de-risking; Anthropic IPO underperformance could cascade into crypto sentiment crash.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps (leverage 3–5x) against short SPY call spreads, or buy 60-day ATM BTC call, fund with short 120-day ITM BTC put.
